terms.comment: With red hips that are not eaten raw.

phrases.latin: Nōn sunt corna; rosae canīnae bācae sunt, quae crūdae rārō eduntur.
phrases.english: They aren’t cornelian cherries; they’re dog-rose hips, which are seldom eaten raw.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
